# Astrolya

> Astrolya is a free Vedic astrology app connecting users with real, live astrologers for chat and call consultations, alongside free Kundli (birth chart) generation, daily horoscopes, on-device AI-personalized palm and face reading, tarot, and traditional remedies. Available in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam.

## About

- [Homepage](https://astrolya.in/): Features, trust & privacy information, supported languages, and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://astrolya.in/privacy-policy.html): What data Astrolya collects and how it's used, including that palm/face photos are analyzed on-device and never uploaded.
- [Terms of Service](https://astrolya.in/terms-of-service.html)

## Key facts

- Live astrologers across Vedic Astrology, KP Astrology, Nadi Astrology, Numerology, Tarot, Psychic Reading, Vastu Shastra, Face Reading & Palmistry, and Life Coaching.
- Free Kundli (birth chart) generation from exact birth date, time and place.
- Palm and face reading photos are analyzed entirely on-device; the photo itself is never uploaded to any server - only derived measurements are used to generate the reading.
- Kundli matching (Guna Milan / Ashtakoot Milan) for marriage compatibility, with full astrologer interpretation beyond the raw score.
- Payments are processed through Google Play Billing; Astrolya never sees card details.
- Available in 6 languages: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam.
